subject: Launch orchestration: Arcadia Health — ownership & risk debrief
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta@arcadiahealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Launch orchestration: Arcadia Health — ownership & risk debrief

Team —

Quick handoff note for Arcadia Health (deal RW-2027-1453). Signed LOI; legal sent SOW v1 (attached). High-level context and asks below so CS/Implementation can scope and take ownership.

Why this matters
- Customer: Arcadia Health (regional provider network; piloting Redwood for a mix of internal notes summarization and clinical chatbot in a single-tenant environment).
- Value: Will be used by ~150 clinicians in pilot, expected token volume ~1.2M/month post-pilot; target latency <= 400ms for short answers.
- Commercial: 12-month committed Dedicated pool + usage tiers. Final SOW expected signed by 2027-09-15.

Key technical constraints
- Data residency: All patient-derived input must remain in their VPC; they will run Private deployment (VPC peering).
- SSO: Okta SAML 2.0 required with SCIM provisioning.
- Throughput: Peak concurrency target 120 qps for short prompts during morning shift spikes.
- Biosafety / PII: Customer requires audit-level request/response logs retained for 365 days, redaction of direct identifiers preferred.

Immediate asks / expectations
1) Primary CS owner assigned and intro to customer by EOD Thu (2027-09-09).
2) Technical kickoff (30–60m) with Arcadia infra + our infra engineering by 2027-09-15 to validate network & SSO.
3) Draft deployment readiness checklist and MOP (runbook) by 2027-09-12 so legal/procurement can attach to SOW.
4) Confirm any blocking procurement items (e.g., approved IP allowlist ranges, KMS/HSM requirements) so we can surface to finance.

Proposed owner assignments (sales view)
- CS Lead (primary): Naomi Feldman — owner for pilot success milestones and acceptance criteria.
- Infra / Deployment lead: Vivek Kulkarni — owner for VPC, peering, and capacity planning.
- Billing / Contract follow-up: Tessa Morgan — procurement & billing sign-off.
- Sales Sponsor / Escalation: Rishi Malhotra — sales escalation and exec touchpoints.

Attachments: Arcadia_StatementOfWork_v1.pdf; deployment_matrix.xlsx; MOP-arcadia-v1.md (links in Drive).

Next steps (for this thread)
- Vivek: internal pre-kickoff to validate capacity on 2027-09-08 (suggest 10:00 PT) — please confirm.
- Naomi: intro email to Arcadia once internal owners confirm.
- Tessa: flag any unusual billing/legal items (C2C export controls, additional indemnities).

Thanks — short and pragmatic please, we want a crisp handover so CS can own the timeline.

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-09-06T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch orchestration: Arcadia Health — ownership & risk debrief

Thanks Rishi — good summary.

I can run the infra/deployment workstream. Naomi, are you able to be the CS pilot lead? If so I'll schedule an internal pre-kickoff to run the network and capacity checklist and call out any infra blockers.

Initial notes I want the team to consider (high-priority risks):
- VPC peering + private deployment: we need Arcadia to provide expected CIDR ranges and the names/IPs of their outbound proxies. If there are egress inspection devices that terminate TLS, we must validate TLS passthrough for the inference path.
- KMS/HSM: they mentioned HSM for key storage — confirm whether Redwood-managed KMS acceptable or customer-managed (we should capture requirement in SOW).
- SSO: Okta metadata + test user account required before the kickoff. SCIM provisioning will be scoped post-kickoff.
- Log retention and export: 365 days retention needs retention tiering and potential costs; Tessa please put an estimated delta on cost-of-storage for review.

I propose: internal pre-kickoff Tue 2027-09-08 10:00 PT (30m). Agenda: 1) review CIDR/KMS/Okta expectations; 2) throughput sizing; 3) responsibilities for runbook authoring.

Naomi, if you confirm ownership I will send the internal invite and draft the external kickoff invite for 2027-09-15.

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Deployments | Redwood Inference
